question: How does one 70-case isolated application suite scale at parallelism1/2/4/8 with the released Go helper versus shared and worker-schema Testcontainers?
decision_informed: Publish a bounded timeline/latency comparison, with no preselected winner and no product changes.

matrix.order: rotate modes by repetition and parallelism

timing: External process wall including boot, Ryuk first-use, schema/master/sample input, per-case admission/reset/Fork/SQL, all owned DB/pool/container cleanup and test-process exit. Image acquisition and compilation excluded.
oracles: Exact shared testcase assertions, pristine input before every case, same70casenames, no overlap between shared writers/readers, bounded admission, helper cleanup, containerID absence. Corrupt-seed negative control must fail.
exit: Compare medians/ranges and median-run timeline for each mode and parallelism; preserve FAIL/partial data. No general engine/VM memory or compatibility claim.
